name: 模板包 - 状态流转与并发风险点覆盖
description: 覆盖总纲风险点#15-#20：模板包状态回退IDLE→DRAFT验证、setValid并发场景、标签缓存验证

steps.expression: (() => { const cards = document.querySelectorAll('.ant-card, [class*=card]'); for (const c of cards) { const text = c.textContent; const match = text.match(/(\d+)个/); if (match && parseInt(match[1]) > 0) { const btn = c.querySelector('button, a, span'); const detailBtn = [...c.querySelectorAll('button, a, span')].find(b => b.textContent.includes('查看详情')); if (detailBtn) { detailBtn.click(); return { clicked: true, packageCount: parseInt(match[1]) }; } } } return { clicked: false }; })()
steps.description: 点击有模板包店铺的查看详情

steps.expression: (() => { const text = document.body.innerText; return { hasStatus: text.includes('DRAFT') || text.includes('IDLE') || text.includes('审核') || text.includes('状态'), hasPackageList: text.includes('模板') || text.includes('模版') }; })()
steps.description: 检查详情页是否展示状态信息

steps.expression: (() => { const text = document.body.innerText; const activeMatches = text.match(/使用中|激活|有效/g); return { activeCount: activeMatches ? activeMatches.length : 0, pageText: text.substring(0, 500) }; })()

steps.description: 导航到淘内资源池验证标签缓存

steps.expression: (() => { const text = document.body.innerText; return { hasTagFilter: text.includes('标签筛选'), tagDimensions: ['设计', '搭配', '拍摄', '场景', '光影', '构图', '视觉'].filter(d => text.includes(d)) }; })()
steps.description: 验证标签维度是否正确加载（非过期缓存）

_testDesign.preconditions: F88预发已登录（buc）。存在有模板包的店铺。
_testDesign.realDomNotes: 风险点#15:setValid并发竞态; #16:标签缓存永不失效; #20:状态回退IDLE→DRAFT。需通过UI+API组合验证。
riskPoints: 详情页可能无显式状态文本
缓存验证需对比前后端数据一致性
